test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A doctor who attends to bone problems
solution: The correct answer is '​orthopaedist.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let us see the meanings of the given options: • **Pathologist**: a scientist who studies the causes and effects of diseases, especially one who examines laboratory samples of body tissue for diagnostic or forensic purposes. (एक वैज्ञानिक जो रोगों के कारणों और प्रभावों का अध्ययन करता है, विशेष रूप से वह जो नैदानिक ​​या फोरेंसिक उद्देश्यों के लिए शरीर के ऊतकों के प्रयोगशाला नमूनों की जांच करता है।) • **Paediatrician**: a medical practitioner specializing in children and their diseases. (बच्चों और उनके रोगों में विशेषज्ञता वाला एक चिकित्सक।) • **Orthopaedist**: a doctor who specializes in the branch of medicine concerned with the correction or prevention of deformities, disorders, or injuries of the skeleton and associated structures. (एक डॉक्टर जो विकृति, विकारों, या कंकाल और संबंधित संरचनाओं की चोटों के सुधार या रोकथाम से संबंधित दवा की शाखा में माहिर हैं।) • **Cardiologist**: a doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases and heart abnormalities. (एक डॉक्टर जो हृदय रोगों और हृदय संबंधी असामान्यताओं के अध्ययन या उपचार में विशेषज्ञता रखता है।) • Hence, a doctor who attends to bone problems is called an orthopaedist. • Therefore, the correct answer is '​orthopaedist.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us see the meaning of the following group of words: Group of words One word अर्थ The place where dogs are kept Kennel कुत्ता-घर The place where cats are kept Cattery बिल्ली देखभाल गृह ed:T256a, The correct answer is** 'Cornelius told Pauline that that house had been far too large for him since the death of his wife.'**
